exception.rationale: Explicit read-only audit mode cannot edit, install, publish, or alter authentication. The bounded event projection uses authorized files, finite budgets, context-aware deduplication, private-payload redaction, and separate transport/shell/unknown outcomes without inferring intended test reds.
